title: Dawning Isles
wikitext:
[[image:The Dawning Isles.jpg|thumb|The Dawning Isles]]
'''The Dawning Isles''' used to be an idyllic set of low keys that rose from the crystalline surface of [[Lordamere Lake]], but have now been affected by the [[Plague of Undeath]]. The trees have grown sickly, and dangerous [[murloc]]s and [[bog beast]]s now roam the islets.

The Dawning Isles along with the larger [[Fenris Isle]] used to form the rim of an ancient volcano, long since eroded away by the elements. Deep fissures can still be seen riddling the lakebed below the surface.
